original.statement: Istiod's validation webhook is improved to accept API versions it does not recognize, ensuring an older Istio can validate resources created by newer CRDs.

decision.reason: [ev-0f8bce94541e] says Istiod's validation webhook now accepts versions it does not know about, so an older Istio can validate resources created by newer CRDs. That is a change in how the webhook behaves at runtime, not a field, flag or default, so behavior-changed on a protocol-behavior subject with component istiod (named in the text) fits. The kebab-case name stays close to the text's wording ("validation webhook", "accept", versions it does not know about). A shorter spelling such as validation-webhook-unknown-versions would also have been acceptable.
